biggest_catch: Only licensed/credentialed professionals pass the third-party verification — and earnings depend on how many questions you answer.
catches: Every expert is verified by a third-party firm — you need real credentials, licenses, or substantial professional experience.
Earnings depend on the volume of questions you choose to answer; nothing guaranteed.
Payouts are monthly via Hyperwallet (direct deposit, PayPal, or Venmo US-only).
Application review takes 4-7 days (US/Canada) to 2-4 weeks elsewhere.

c1.evidence: JustAnswer's official expert-recruitment page (era.justanswer.com) states: 'There are no scheduled shifts. You set your own hours and choose the questions you want to answer whenever you want, 24/7.' and 'You always get to choose which questions you answer and you get paid for those questions.' Customers post questions; experts answer via chat, call, or text — a live, provider-owned deal channel.

c2.evidence: Official: 'You decide how much you bring in depending on the volume of questions you choose to answer' — variable.

c3.evidence: Steps follow the official flow: apply with credentials, pass third-party verification, get approved by email, onboard, choose questions and answer them.

c4.evidence: Official: 'At JustAnswer, there are no sign-up fees required to apply for talented individuals... There are no sign-up fees or costs associated with joining our platform as an Expert.'

eligibility: Licensed or credentialed professionals (vets, lawyers, doctors, CPAs, licensed trades, tech pros, appraisers) verified by a third-party firm.
notes: Scenario: professional Q&A answers. JustAnswer connects licensed experts with customers asking legal, medical, tech, automotive, tax, appraisal, and home-improvement questions. Experts choose which questions to answer and get paid for each; monthly payouts via Hyperwallet. Professional credentials are strictly verified — variable, never guaranteed.
